paragraphs.text: This is the wicked counsel of his enemies to him and his companions to drive him from the hope of God's promise.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: Flee as a bird to your

paragraphs.text: All hope of help is taken away.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Yet am I innocent and my cause good.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Though all things in earth are out of order, yet God will execute judgment from heaven.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: As in the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Which they will drink even to the dregs, Eze 23:34.
